title: Singularity of Bernoulli convolutions at quartic Salem reciprocals
exact_target: For every quartic Salem algebraic integer beta in (1,2), is the Bernoulli convolution given by the distribution of $sum_{n>=0}$ $\epsilon _n$ $\beta ^{-n}$, with independent equiprobable $\epsilon _n$ in \{-1,1\}, singular with respect to Lebesgue measure?
